description: Independent test set: 6 real BOAMP tenders never used to develop or tune the matching (none is in real_tenders.json). Requirement lines are the words of the notice (BOAMP gives the notice only, not the full specification): 'notice' = a sentence or phrase of the notice body, 'title' = the notice title, 'n8n' = the line the pipeline's analysis LLM sent to the RAG for that tender (kept as sent). No line was written or reworded for this set.
